categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies Tor control port integration logic to validate cookie files and restrict SOCKS listener addresses.
categories.rationale: Hardens Tor control port handling against traffic redirection and node shutdown hangs caused by rogue local listeners. The PR description notes that 'A program that answers on the Tor control port can hang the node at shutdown and point its onion connections at another host.'

categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: File reading changes support Tor control cookie handling rather than introducing general shared infrastructure.
categories.rationale: Changes to file reading logic follow directly from the Tor control port hardening and do not represent general utility modifications.
